If you're obsessed with The Coworker and Want to Know a Secret? by Freida McFadden, you'll be gripped by The Morning After. An utterly addictive psychological thriller with twists that will have you gasping out loud.

'Keeps you guessing until the explosive end' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
'All I can say is READ IT' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
'I was hooked from the start' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
'A twist I would never see coming' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

The nightmare starts the moment you wake up...

Last night is a blur.

Laura has memories of drinking and laughing at the office party – dancing with a handsome man.

This morning, there’s a blue shirt on her bedroom floor.

But she’s certain that the man she went home with was wearing pink.

Panic sets in. Laura realises that someone she trusts, one of her colleagues, has betrayed her. She’s desperate to find them before they hurt anyone else.

What she doesn’t realise is that they’re watching her every move... And the danger has only just begun.

Readers can't get enough of The Morning After
